prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE unified UI component design sheet showing all FOUR dropdown types for the 同拍 ONEBEAT PRO drum arrangement editor.
Primary request: make style, main pattern, fill, and frequency dropdowns all use ONE consistent anchored speech-bubble popover visual language, derived from supplied Scheme A. This is a polished product UI design image, not a wireframe, not code, not a poster illustration.
Input image 1: Scheme A reference for typography, warm cream surface, coral/lilac palette, shallow hard black offset shadows, section header, field buttons, and especially small triangular popover pointer. Preserve its app design identity. This is a new component design sheet, not a full-page edit.
Canvas/composition: one large high-resolution portrait or square sheet, ideally 2048x2560, with a very clear 2 by 2 comparison grid. Large top title "定制鼓机 · 统一气泡下拉". Small subtitle "同一套外观，四种选择". Four independent scenarios labelled 01 风格 / 02 节奏型 / 03 加花 / 04 频率. Each scenario is an enlarged realistic fragment of the SAME 段落 A in 摇滚 style. Do not show all four open at once on one app screen. Each cell has generous breathing space, a clearly visible original trigger above a complete open bubble. No phone frames, no four tiny full app screenshots, no characters or mascots. Minimal fading coral and lilac halftone decoration at sheet corners only.
Visual system shared EXACTLY across all four bubbles: warm white #FFFDF7 body, near-black #171B1F 2vp outline, 12vp corner radius, a little integrated outlined triangular tail pointing up toward its own triggering button. Tail body same fill, no horizontal border line crossing the tail base. Hard ink shadow offset lower-right 4vp, tiny radius 1vp, never a soft floating/glass shadow. Inner padding 12vp. Header 16vp bold black; divider under header. Every option is a rounded rectangle with 1vp black outline, 7vp radius, at least 44vp tall, 8vp gaps. Unselected options all use same cream #FFF9EE. Selected option uses the SAME coral #FF7056 fill plus black ✓ at right across all 4 menus; never rely on fill only. Text near-black bold 14-15vp, clean legible Chinese. No chevrons on option items because selecting immediately applies and closes. All open triggers show an up-chevron; no native dropdown visuals.
Scenario01 风格:
Show original section header fragment "段落 A ⌃", coral "摇滚 ⌃" trigger near right, tiny delete× at far right. Bubble underneath, with its tail aligned to that style trigger. Bubble title exactly "段落 A · 选择风格". Content TWO-COLUMN grid of ALL TWELVE real existing styles, SIX rows in this order:
row1 摇滚 ✓ | 迷幻
row2 爵士 | 放克
row3 迪斯科 | 嘻哈
row4 陷阱 | 浩室
row5 科技舞曲 | 鼓打贝斯
row6 拉丁 | 雷鬼
Only 摇滚 is selected/coral. Each option may include a tiny style-color dot left of its label, but the unselected rectangular backgrounds remain cream, never individually filled with different colors. Footer after a divider: "只修改这一段" in small gray. ALL12 names fully readable, not a 更多 button.
Scenario02 节奏型:
Trigger row exactly "节奏型 [八分摇滚 ⌃] [试听] [编辑]" with familiar lilac audition/edit buttons outside bubble. Bubble tail points to the pattern field, not the neighboring audition button. Title "段落 A · 选择节奏型". THREE single-column options with full labels "八分摇滚 ✓", "反拍开镲", "叮镲推进". First selected. No new options, no added sample controls, no play icons inside this menu. Small gray context "摇滚" alongside title if space permits.
Scenario03 加花:
Trigger row exactly "加花 [军鼓短句 ⌃] [试听] [编辑]". Bubble tail points to fill field. Title "段落 A · 选择加花". THREE single-column options "军鼓短句 ✓", "重音滚奏", "通鼓下行". First selected. Optional small gray 摇滚 context by title. Match the pattern menu size, spacing, border and selection exactly.
Scenario04 频率:
Trigger row exactly "频率 [每4小节 ⌃]". Bubble title "段落 A · 加花频率". FIVE single-column options "每1小节", "每2小节", "每4小节 ✓", "每8小节", "每16小节". Third selected/coral. Tail points to frequency field. No 不加花 option because it is not an existing choice.
At the bottom of the sheet a restrained three-part rule strip, outside runtime UI, text exactly "点击选项即应用" / "点击空白处关闭" / "同一时间只展开一个". Do not add confirmation buttons or bottom sheets. No dimensions printed over the UI, no unrelated navigation changes.
Critical checks: all FOUR menus visible, every menu uses integrated triangular pointer, consistent black outlines and hard shadows, selected coral+check everywhere, actual Chinese option names and full lists above preserved. Show the complete bubble bodies without clipping offscreen. Top two panels may be taller to accommodate the 12-style menu; bottom row still roomy. Crisp finished app UI image, no sketch lines.
